summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Analytics with Excel Training Course. Learn to analyze data effectively and make informed decisions using Excel tools.
lede: Excel data analysis helps professionals turn structured business records into validated reports and useful findings. For users with basic worksheet skills, the course builds a repeatable workflow for preparing data in Power Query, examining patterns with PivotTables, and verifying calculations before presenting results through interactive dashboards.
audienceIntro: This Excel data analysis course is designed for professionals who prepare, examine, reconcile, or present structured business information. It suits foundation-to-intermediate users who can enter data and use basic worksheets but need a more controlled analytical workflow.
modules: Excel Reporting Controls and Action Plans
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with Excel worksheets, cell references, data entry, and simple formulas such as SUM. No coding or programming is required for completion. You should bring a laptop with a supported desktop edition of Microsoft Excel that includes Power Query, PivotTables, and the Analysis ToolPak; Power Pivot availability may depend on your licence and installation. Advanced statistics, DAX, forecasting, Solver, and AI-assisted analysis are taught at conceptual awareness or guided operational application level rather than technical engineering depth.
